source.title: European Rubik's Cube Championship 2008 on September 19/20/21, 2008 in Derio (Bilbao), Spain
source.content: The [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2008](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2008) will take place on September 19/20/21, 2008 in Derio (Bilbao), Spain. Check out the [Euro 2008 website](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/euro2008/) for more information and registration.      ![](http://www.speedcubing.com/images/euro2008.jpg)

translation.title: 2008 年欧洲魔方锦标赛将于 9 月 19–21 日在西班牙德里奥举行
translation.content:
[2008 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2008)将于 2008 年 9 月 19、20、21 日在西班牙德里奥（毕尔巴鄂）举行。详情及报名请查看 [Euro 2008 官网](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/euro2008/)。

![2008 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](http://www.speedcubing.com/images/euro2008.jpg)
